To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the neutrino(anti-neutrino) induced charged current quasielastic lepton and pion production processes in nuclei are affected by nuclear medium effects.
the neutrino-nucleus cross sections in the few Gev energy range, which are important for present neutrino experiments, can not be described by the free nucleon cross sections.
the nuclear medium effects are important for the quasi-elastic lepton production, charged-current pion production and neutral-current pion production in neutrino(antineurino) scattering off nuclei.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the nuclear effects in the neutrinos induced reactions in nuclei and its impact on the neutrino oscillation experiment.
the study of nuclear medium effects in neutrino-nucleus interactions in the few Gev energy region.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the nuclear medium effects are not negligible in the neutrino oscillation experiment.
nuclear medium effects can not be ignored in neutrino oscillations experiments, specially in the quasielastic and the pion production channels.
the nuclear effects are not very important in the case of the atmospheric neutrinos, whereas they are important for the case of accelerator neutrino experiments like K2K, MINOS and NO$\nu$A.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, the quasielastic lelectron production cross sections in nuclei are reduced due to Pauli blocking, Fermi motion of nucleons and the nuclear medium modification of the axial vector form factor of the nucleon.
the nuclear effects in the charged current pion production process are found to be more important than the quasielastic process for the neutrino oscillation experiment.

the nuclear medium effects are found to reduce the quasielastic lelectron production cross sections by a factor of 1.3-1.5 for the neutrino induced interactions and by a factor of about 2 for the antineutrino induced interactions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
nuclear effects in the neutrinos induced interactions in nuclei are important for understanding the oscillation results from present and future experiments.
the nuclear effects can be important in neutrino oscillations in the few Gev energy region and hence should be included in the theoretical calculations for neutrino oscillation analyses.
the nuclear effects can significantly modify the neutrino oscillation parameters.
